$comment: Mutations of index.json that BOTH registry implementations must ACCEPT: each sets the permissions of /plugins/0/versions/0 to `value`, a list that is well formed but names at least one permission this client does not support (a future one, or a reserved one it knows and refuses). The index still parses, that version entry reports exactly `unsupported` and is not installable (the desktop shows "Needs newer Petal"), and every other entry is unaffected. Keeps an older client's "Get plugins" working when the registry lists a plugin that needs a newer Petal.

cases.name: several future permissions keep their order
a future permission with a host-like argument
a reserved permission is known and refused, per entry
a permission at exactly 64 chars is well formed
